# David Santiago Vargas (krespokiller)

> Tech Lead specialized in fintech payment platforms and multi-tenant systems for Latin American markets. Leads a team of 5 engineers building event-driven architecture and cloud infrastructure with TypeScript, Python, NestJS, React, PostgreSQL, Azure, and AWS.

This site is a single-page 3D portfolio (React, TypeScript, three.js). Content sections:

## Selected Work (#work)
Three case studies:
- **Loopay Suite** — multi-tenant, cloud-native fintech payments platform for Latin American markets; leads a team of 5 engineers on SOBERANA, the cross-border payments platform; led the AWS-to-Azure migration with the CTO (Terraform, GitHub Actions over OIDC); 60% faster deploys (15 to 6 minutes) on the AWS pipeline.
  - https://soberana.app/
- **Galgo** — motorcycle e-commerce with embedded financing in Colombia; Checkout and Risk teams building NestJS services, a backend-for-frontend layer and Next.js interfaces on event-driven microservices.
  - https://www.galgo.com/co
- **Trebet** — mobile super-app for residential communities (payments, digital intercom, bookings, assembly voting); co-founded with a remote team of 7; MVP to production in about a month.
  - https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.trebet&hl=es_CO
  - https://apps.apple.com/us/app/trebet/id6748287035
